import itertools, json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ctypes
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
import reference
from netnomos.finite import compile_job

DOMAINS = [[0,1,10,11,100,999999,1000000], [0], [5,50,500], [1,2,3,12,123,1234], list(range(0,20))]
PREFIXES = ['', '0', '00', '01', '1', '10', '100', '1000', '999999', '9999999', '100000', '1000000', '2', '5', '50', '12', '123']
OPS = ['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge']

fails = 0
cases = 0
for di, domain in enumerate(DOMAINS):
    for slots in (1, 2):
        fields = [{'name':'v','type':'size','domain':domain}]
        preds = [{'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[s,'v']},'op':op,'right':{'const':c,'type':'size'}}
                 for s in range(slots) for op in OPS for c in (0, 10, 100, 1000000)]
        preds += [{'kind':k,'field':'v','op':op,'value':c} for k in ('any','all') for op in OPS for c in (0,1,10,1000)]
        rng = random.Random(di * 13 + slots)
        for trial in range(12):
            train = [[[rng.choice(domain) for _ in range(1)] for _ in range(slots)] for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 5))]
            width = rng.randint(1, 3)
            approved = [sorted(rng.sample(range(len(preds)), rng.randint(1, width))) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 6))]
            queries = [{'fixed': ([{'ref':[0,'v'],'value':rng.choice(domain)}] if rng.random()<0.3 else []),
                        'target':[rng.randrange(slots),'v'],'prefix':rng.choice(PREFIXES)} for _ in range(6)]
            job = {'fields':fields,'slots':slots,'predicates':preds,'width':width,'train':train,
                   'approved':approved,'queries':queries}
            cases += 1
            expect = reference.solve(job)
            got = compile_job(job)
            if json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True) != json.dumps(expect, sort_keys=True):
                fails += 1
                print('MISMATCH', di, slots, trial)
                print(json.dumps(job))
                print('exp', json.dumps(expect)[:1500])
                print('got', json.dumps(got)[:1500])
                if fails > 1: sys.exit(1)
print('cases', cases, 'fails', fails)
PY
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/test_digits.py 2>&1 | tail -6
